digest.component_or_area: CLI edit and claim commands with embedded plan-review verification
propositions: edit --review must parse as a valueless flag without consuming the next token, then invoke review_plan after the EDIT commit and exit with disposition codes 0/1/2/11 per ADR-0040

claim --review must call claim_gate_check and review_plan only when the gate applies, proceed to claim core only on PASS verdict, and exit 1/2/11 without claiming on BLOCK/INDETERMINATE/retryable stubs
Both flags must obtain _disposition_exit_code via lazy in-function import from _cli/_llm_commands.py following the established pattern, and neither flag may be cascaded through parent-first flows
The store lock must not be held during LLM review execution; edit commits under the short-lived lock then releases before invoking review_plan, and claim behaves identically
Exceptions raised by review_plan must propagate through the standard CLI error handler with the edit already committed (edit --review) or the claim core never invoked (claim --review)
Help texts must document non-atomicity and reference review-plan --status; docs/exit-codes.md must document the new --review exit codes and confirm flagless contracts are unchanged
